title: Teach-back rubric
note: Each trainer runs one 10-minute part of the course for a group of 4. Each line is scored 1 to 4.

lines.name: Timing
lines.four_looks_like: Finishes in time and keeps the part that must never be cut

lines.name: Clarity
lines.four_looks_like: Plain words, one instruction at a time, uses the slide and notes; reads each exercise's steps, then says them once in plain Arabic

lines.name: Practice
lines.four_looks_like: Participants do the task; the trainer walks the room and checks each person's work is done

lines.name: Judgment and safety
lines.four_looks_like: Catches an AI mistake or a privacy slip (names in AI, a draft sent unread) and handles it as the notes say
